title: 10 Areas of Society To Work In
text: [music] I'm going to give everybody a job now. Ready? Write it. Get a pen. This is your job. Find one of these areas to work in. I call them the pillars of influence in your society. Number one, politics. Go into government. Number two, economics. Go into the world of money. Number three, business. Go into commerce and influence that world for Jesus in the kingdom. Number four, judicial. Go into law and become a lawyer, young man. That area needs the kingdom. Number five, health. Go into the health care system and bring the kingdom there. Don't go work for money. Work for influence. Number six, education. Go and impact the training of the minds of the future. Those kids are so pliable. We need kingdom people in the classroom cuz right now we got devils in the classroom. Don't complain. Go in the classroom. The world number seven of arts, entertainment. Go into music and acting and drama. That's the world. You got to go into that world. And number eight, recreation, the world of sports. Go be an athlete. Join a football team or become a part of the of the ice hockey. IN OTHER WORDS, GET INVOLVED. YOU SAY, "WELL, I know I'm a Christian. I can't play hockey." Oh, shut up, man. Go into the world of hockey. And some of you parents need to repent. Keeping your kids out of these worlds. They must go into those worlds AND IMPACT IT FOR JESUS. Bring the kingdom to those worlds. Number nine, the world of media. Boy, this a serious one. That's why the media is destroying nations because the saints ain't in the media. They lock you out. I want you to go ahead and learn how to be a good anchor woman, an anchor man for the news. They don't know who you are until it's too late. You got yeast sitting in front of the TV. And you choose the stories that you read. And they're not all murder, but you got to be in there to do that. So go into media, young woman, young man, go ahead and be an anchor. Be the the weatherman and put on one of the pins. Let me tell the camera this is a special weather pin. Number 10, the pillar of social impact. That means all the social sciences, welfare, sociology, social work, community building. These are worlds. We need the kingdom in every pillar.
